description: Counts of the Social tab's Reddit and X threads: total, by stage (identified, replyDrafted, engaged for posted, skipped), opened (replies you opened on the platform that aren't on the thread yet, also counted in replyDrafted), by platform (reddit, twitter) and by age (ranked, new), plus replies drafted in the last 30 days with and without a product mention (mention30d, helpful30d). All zeros until threads are found; list_social_threads returns the threads.
name: get_social_stats
